clips.title: The story
paras: Bristleback Attack Plans warn of a planned siege on Camp Narache. Quilboar of Brambleblade Ravine drew crude maps and tactical notes for an assault meant to overrun the tauren settlement.

The Bristleback quilboar plan a sustained assault on Camp Narache. Their leadership means to push beyond skirmishes along the borders of the Red Cloud Mesa and wipe out the young tauren training there. The plans lie deep within a dirt cave in Brambleblade Ravine. Chief Hawkwind can send word to Bloodhoof Village for reinforcements, giving Camp Narache a chance to blunt the invasion before it begins.
